messages.subject: 12 findings (4 High): branch claim only half delivered
messages.body: Reviewed the full branch (0ae9174408..HEAD is empty; all 10 modified + 2 untracked files are uncommitted) and ran the gates read-only: 181 main-process SSH tests, 538 pty-connection tests, and oxfmt --check all pass. Found 12 proven findings (4 High / 4 Medium / 4 Low): the initial-connect path never opens a budget window at all (SshConnection.connect() throws without calling scheduleReconnect, and deadlineFor has exactly one production call site), so the headline 'dead host + pane remounts' case is still an unbounded ~160s-per-call storm; the 60s wall-clock budget only fits TWO attempts against a black-holed host (CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=30s) versus nine before, never re-arms itself, and burns while the process is suspended, so any 61s outage — host reboot, VPN reconnect, or a lid-close where the drop was seen before sleep — permanently parks every SSH workspace until a human clicks Connect, with the new powerMonitor guard also skipping the #7773 wake-recovery path. Remaining work is the author's: fix H4 (charge the window on failed auto connects), H3 (reset on resume), H1/H2 (raise or slow-re-arm the budget), and M2b (the overlay drops AUTO_RECONNECT_PAUSED_MESSAGE, so the user is never told Orca stopped trying); full evidence with file:line in the report.
